newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan Arab Aluminum posts 96 profit rise.
newsitem.headline: Jordan Arab Aluminum posts 96 profit rise.

text.p: Jordan's Arab Aluminum Industries Company posted a 6 percent rise in its 1996 net profits to 2.5 million dinars despite a similar drop in sales, the company's released results showed on Wednesday.
The rise in net profits was attributed to lower corporate taxes after a major overhaul of corporate taxation last year which has helped boost most company earnings.

The balance sheet showed that its pre-tax profits fell in 1996 to 2.947 million dinars from 3.279 million dinars in 1995. It was mainly due to a a drop in sales of the company's products, mostly aluminium for construction purposes.
Net sales fell to 12 million dinars in 1996 from 12.8 million dinars in 1995, the company's balance sheet showed.
